def _cart_position(event, item, membership=None):
    return CartPosition(event=event, item=item, price=Decimal('23.00'), used_membership=membership)


def _membership(customer, membership_type, date_start, date_end, testmode=False, canceled=False):
    return customer.memberships.create(
        membership_type=membership_type, date_start=date_start, date_end=date_end, testmode=testmode, canceled=canceled,
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_no_membership_required(event, customer):
    item = Item.objects.create(event=event, name='Plain ticket', default_price=Decimal('23.00'), admission=True)
    validate_memberships_in_order(None, [_cart_position(event, item)], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, item)], event, lock=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event,
                                  lock=True, testmode=False)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_missing(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_no_customer(event, membership, requiring_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(None, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_other_customer(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    other = event.organizer.customers.create(email="jane@example.org")
    membership_type = requiring_ticket.require_membership_types.get()
    foreign = _membership(other, membership_type, datetime(2021, 4, 1, tzinfo=TZ), datetime(2021, 4, 30, tzinfo=TZ))
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, foreign)], event)

    membership = _membership(customer, other_type, datetime(2021, 4, 1, tzinfo=TZ), datetime(2021, 4, 30, tzinfo=TZ))
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)

        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_testmode(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event,
                                      testmode=True)

    test_membership = _membership(customer, membership.membership_type, membership.date_start, membership.date_end,
                                  testmode=True)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, test_membership)], event,
                                  testmode=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid_from_not_chosen(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    membership_type = requiring_ticket.require_membership_types.get()
    # Only starts after the event, but has not ended yet
    upcoming = _membership(customer, membership_type, now() + timedelta(days=10), now() + timedelta(days=40))
    position = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, upcoming)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [position], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [position], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)

    # Has already ended
    ended = _membership(customer, membership_type, now() - timedelta(days=40), now() - timedelta(days=10))
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, ended)], event,
                                      valid_from_not_chosen=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_usage_limit(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.save()
    q = event.quotas.create(size=None, name="foo")
    q.items.add(requiring_ticket)
    cp1 = CartPosition.objects.create(
        item=requiring_ticket, price=23, expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id="123",
        used_membership=membership
    )
    order = _create_order(event, email='dummy@example.org', positions=[cp1],
                          now_dt=now(),
                          sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
                          payment_requests=[{
                              "id": "test0",
                              "provider": "banktransfer",
                              "max_value": None,
                              "min_value": None,
                              "multi_use_supported": False,
                              "info_data": {},
                              "payment_amount": Decimal("23.00"),
                              "pprov": BankTransfer(event)
                          }],
                          locale='de', customer=customer)[0]

    # The only usage is by the order itself, so it is fine when that order is being changed
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event,
                                  ignored_order=order)

    # Two positions in the same purchase may not exceed the limit either
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [
            _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership),
            _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership),
        ], event, ignored_order=order)
